limitations: Two full 64-bit thread IDs with the same 32-bit hash, one notification action, one queued worker and separate SMS/MMS acknowledgements. Current role admission occurs when the worker begins. No fairness or provider success is assumed.

Five exact Android JVM cases exercise actual notification/PendingIntent identities, MessagingStyle retained text, compose-only reply, the actual receiver and its completion future, and actual SQL provider update predicates for shown/later/foreign/sent rows, role loss and partial provider failure.

Read predicates are abstracted to selected-thread membership; timestamp units/cutoffs are checked by actual SQLite tests. Separate provider writes can partially succeed. Real default-SMS role grants, system Telephony provider enforcement, carrier delivery, audio/video, system notification rendering and process death remain external. Reply never invokes the send journal or radio.
